articles.title: Adalimumab: A Review of its Use in Adult Patients with Rheumatoid Arthritis
articles.abstract: Adalimumab (Humira) is a fully human anti-tumour necrosis factor (TNF) monoclonal antibody that specifically binds to TNF-alpha and blocks its interaction with the p55 and p75 cell surface TNF receptors. This article reviews the use of adalimumab in adult patients with moderate to severely active rheumatoid arthritis (RA).

articles.title: Biosimilars of adalimumab: current status and future perspectives
articles.abstract: Adalimumab (Humira) was the first fully human anti-TNF monoclonal antibody approved for treating multiple immune-mediated inflammatory conditions. As the originator product faces patent expiry, multiple biosimilar versions are under development or have received regulatory approval.
